conventions.replaces: This file replaces the stale SH-13 contracts.
conventions.basePath: /api. This is the existing SchoolHub convention, not /api/v1. Route files are src/app/api/**/route.ts. (NFR-8)
conventions.handlerPipeline: withHandler → requireUser / requireRole (except the feed and public events) → parseQuery / parseBody with schemas from src/lib/validators/calendar.ts → one service call in src/server/calendar/* → ok(data) / ok(data, {status:201}). Reuse src/server/http.ts; do not hand-roll envelopes. (NFR-8, NFR-9)

envelopes.nonJson: GET /api/events/:id/ics, GET /api/calendar/feed/:token and GET /api/events/:id/rsvps?format=csv return raw bodies (text/calendar or text/csv), not the JSON envelope.

errorPolicy: An event the caller cannot see returns 404 NOT_FOUND, so its existence does not leak. An event cuid is never treated as authorisation. (NFR-5, NFR-7)
A visible event the caller may not change (not the creator and not ADMIN) returns 403 FORBIDDEN with details.reason='NOT_CREATOR'. (FR-8)
A non-admin who sends isNoSchool=true, isPublic=true or category HOLIDAY/TERM_BREAK gets 403 FORBIDDEN with details.reason='ADMIN_ONLY_FIELD' and details.field. (FR-6)
A teacher who targets an audience that fails canTargetAudience gets 403 FORBIDDEN with details.reason='AUDIENCE_NOT_ALLOWED' and details.index (the index in audiences[]). Nothing is written. (FR-7)

An RSVP on an event with rsvpEnabled=false returns 409 CONFLICT with details.reason='RSVP_DISABLED'. An RSVP at or after rsvpDeadline returns 409 CONFLICT with details.reason='RSVP_CLOSED'. A visible event where the caller is not in the audience (for example the creator, or an admin) returns 403 FORBIDDEN with details.reason='NOT_IN_AUDIENCE'. (FR-21)
studentId for a student the caller cannot view returns 404 NOT_FOUND. (FR-11, NFR-7)
A range with to − from > 100 days, or to ≤ from, returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. (FR-32)
A register save on a no-school date without holidayOverride=true returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with details.reason='HOLIDAY_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED' and details.noSchoolReason. (FR-18, D-8)
A rate-limit hit returns 429 RATE_LIMITED with details.retryAfterMs and a Retry-After header in seconds. (FR-27, D-9)
An unknown or reset feed token, or a token whose user is not ACTIVE, returns 404 text/plain 'Not found'. It does not use the JSON envelope, and it does not distinguish the cases. (FR-24, NFR-5)
conventions.ids: All ids are cuid strings. Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC strings. Dates (yyyy-MM-dd) are calendar dates in the school timezone. The client renders times in SchoolSettings.timezone. (NFR-3, NFR-8)
conventions.allDay: All-day input uses startDate/endDate as yyyy-MM-dd with an INCLUSIVE end. The server stores [schoolMidnight(startDate), schoolMidnight(endDate+1)). All-day output gives start/end as UTC instants with an EXCLUSIVE end, plus allDay=true. (FR-4, NFR-3)
conventions.occurrenceIds: An expanded occurrence has id '<eventId>:<occurrenceStartISO>' and eventId '<eventId>'. Every /api/events/:id route takes the plain eventId. Edits apply to the whole series. (FR-15)

AudienceInput.refId: string|null (gradeLevelId | sectionId | courseId | role name for ROLE; must be null for SCHOOL/STAFF)

components.AudienceDTO: AudienceInput & { id: string, label: string (e.g. 'Grade 7 · parents', 'Robotics Club') }

EventInput.title: string, 1..150
EventInput.endAt: ISO datetime ≥ startAt, required when allDay=false
EventInput.endDate: yyyy-MM-dd ≥ startDate, inclusive, required when allDay=true
EventInput.recurrenceUntil: yyyy-MM-dd|null. Required for WEEKLY/MONTHLY, ≤ start + 1 year, ≥ start date. Must be null for NONE.
EventInput.isNoSchool: boolean, optional. ADMIN only. Defaults to category ∈ {HOLIDAY, TERM_BREAK} (FR-5).
EventInput.rsvpDeadline: ISO datetime|null. Required when rsvpEnabled, and must be ≤ the first occurrence's start.

EventDTO.title: string
EventDTO.canRsvp: boolean (rsvpOpen && caller is in the audience)
EventDTO.rsvpTotals: { yes: number, no: number, maybe: number, guests: number } | null (null when rsvpEnabled=false)

RsvpInput.guests: integer 0..5 (default 0). The server forces 0 for non-PARENT callers.

CalendarItem.id: string (occurrence id for events, '<kind>:<entityId>[:<studentId>]' for others, so the id stays unique per child)
CalendarItem.title: string (deadlines for a parent get the prefix '<childName>: ')
CalendarItem.end: string (exclusive when allDay; equals start for deadlines)
CalendarItem.color: string (category colour for events, course/subject colour for deadlines and timetable)
CalendarItem.href: string|null (assignment/quiz page for deadlines, '/calendar?event=<eventId>' for events; FR-13)

FeedStatus.url: string|null ('<APP_URL>/api/calendar/feed/<rawToken>.ics'; non-null only when the token was just created or reset; D-6)

endpoints.description: Merged, expanded, audience-filtered calendar items for the caller, for any role. ADMIN sees every event. Others see events whose audience includes them (or their linked children, for parents) plus events they created. Holidays = HOLIDAY/TERM_BREAK/isNoSchool events; 'events' = all other events, with no overlap. timetable is projected only onto school days. Auth: requireUser. Service: getCalendarItems.

query.to: ISO datetime, required, > from, to − from ≤ 100 days
query.studentId: string, optional. PARENT: a linked child. STUDENT: self only. ADMIN/TEACHER: any student they can view (resolveViewedStudent). Otherwise 404.

endpoints.description: Create an event and replace its audiences in one transaction. Applies the FR-5 isNoSchool default, the admin-only field check (FR-6) and canTargetAudience per audience (FR-7). After commit: if the first occurrence starts within 30 days, notify the resolved audience minus the creator with 'event.holiday_created' (HOLIDAY/TERM_BREAK) or 'event.created', link '/calendar?event=<id>'. Auth: requireRole('ADMIN','TEACHER'). Service: createEvent.

One event (series) as seen by the caller, with myRsvp, rsvpTotals and canEdit/canRsvp. Visibility uses the same audience rule as GET /api/calendar with sources=['events','holidays']. Auth: requireUser. Service: getEvent.

Partial update of the whole series. Every field of EventInput is optional. If audiences is present it replaces the full set, and each entry is re-checked with canTargetAudience. If allDay changes, the matching start/end fields are required. After commit: audit() when an ADMIN edits someone else's event (FR-36). If startAt, endAt, allDay or location changed and the event has an occurrence ending after now, notify 'event.updated' once to the audience minus the editor. Auth: requireUser, then creator or ADMIN. Service: updateEvent.
Delete an event series. Audiences and RSVPs cascade. audit() when an ADMIN deletes someone else's event. No notification. Auth: requireUser, then creator or ADMIN. Service: deleteEvent.

Single-event iCalendar download ('Add to my calendar'). Recurring events are emitted as one VEVENT with RRULE, plus a VTIMEZONE. Auth: requireUser plus the same visibility as GET /api/events/:id. Service: getEvent → buildCalendar([event]).

200.body: RFC 5545 VCALENDAR (CRLF, lines folded at 75 octets, TEXT escaped)

endpoints.description: Create or replace the caller's RSVP for the series. Checks run in this order: visible (404), rsvpEnabled (409 RSVP_DISABLED), isUserInAudience (403 NOT_IN_AUDIENCE), now < rsvpDeadline (409 RSVP_CLOSED). guests is forced to 0 for non-parents. Upsert on (eventId, userId). Auth: requireUser. Service: upsertRsvp.

Full RSVP list for the creator or an ADMIN. With format=csv it streams CSV through src/server/csv.ts, with columns name, role, response, guests, note, updatedAt. Auth: requireUser, then creator or ADMIN. Service: listRsvps.

The caller's feed status. If the caller has no token, one is created (32 random bytes, base64url) and its hash stored, and the URL is returned once. If a token already exists, url is null, because only the hash is stored (D-6). Auth: requireUser. Service: getOrCreateFeedToken.
Replace the caller's token (upsert a new hash). The old URL returns 404 immediately. The new URL is returned once. The raw token is never logged. Auth: requireUser. Service: resetFeedToken.

Private iCal subscription feed, authenticated by token. Route folder: src/app/api/calendar/feed/[token]/route.ts. The handler strips a trailing '.ics' from the param, then hashToken → CalendarFeedToken lookup → user ACTIVE → rateLimit('calfeed:'+tokenHash, 60, 3_600_000) → getCalendarItems(user, now−30d..now+365d, sources events/holidays/assignments/quizzes, series mode) → buildCalendar. Contents match what the user sees in the app. Parents get all their children's audiences and deadlines.

200.body: VCALENDAR with PRODID, X-WR-CALNAME 'SchoolHub', VTIMEZONE for the school tz, VEVENTs (UID '<id>@schoolhub', RRULE for series, VALUE=DATE for all-day with exclusive DTEND, URL on deadlines)

endpoints.description: Is this date a school day, and if not, why. A new singular folder; the existing /api/school-days (PRD-06) is untouched. Auth: requireUser. Service: isSchoolDay.

Public events (isPublic=true), expanded, with public-safe fields only. This is a hook for PRD-18; no UI is added. Auth: none. rateLimit('pubcal:'+getClientIp, 120, 3_600_000). Service: getPublicEvents.

query.to: ISO datetime, required, > from, ≤ from + 100 days

endpoints.description: Create an all-day TERM_BREAK event (isNoSchool=true, SCHOOL audience, title 'Term break') for each gap of at least one day between consecutive terms, from prev.endDate+1 to next.startDate (exclusive). Idempotent: a gap that already has a TERM_BREAK with the same span is skipped. Writes one audit() entry. Sends no event.created notifications. Auth: requireRole('ADMIN'). Service: createTermBreaks.
EXISTING route, extended. getToday adds noSchoolReason so the landing page can show 'No classes today — <reason>'. All other fields are unchanged.

EXISTING route, extended. The register response adds noSchoolReason for the requested date, which drives the RegisterForm warning Alert. All other fields are unchanged. This contract adds the field on top of system-design §2.4, which names only getToday/getOverview; RegisterForm needs it for the banner.
EXISTING route, extended (D-8). registerPutBody gains an optional holidayOverride flag. If isSchoolDay(date) is false and holidayOverride !== true, the save is rejected and nothing is written.

EXISTING cron route, extended. Adds an isolated try/catch block that calls sendRsvpReminders(now). The summary gains rsvpReminders; a failure there is logged and does not fail the other blocks. Auth is unchanged.

200.data: <existing summary> & { rsvpReminders: { events: number, notified: number } }

nonHttpContracts.name: getUpcomingEventsForUser(user, limit = 5): Promise<CalendarItem[]>
nonHttpContracts.description: Hook for PRD-16 dashboards: getCalendarItems(user, now..now+90d, ['events','holidays']), sorted, first `limit` items. No route or UI.

nonHttpContracts.name: isSchoolDay(date: Date | string): Promise<{ isSchoolDay: boolean, reason: string|null }>
nonHttpContracts.description: Called by timetable-service.getScheduleForDate (returns [] when false), attendance-service and GET /api/school-day.

nonHttpContracts.name: Notification types
nonHttpContracts.description: event.created (COMMUNICATION, defaultEmail false), event.holiday_created (COMMUNICATION, defaultEmail true), event.updated (COMMUNICATION, false) and event.rsvp_reminder (COMMUNICATION, false). Payload: { eventId, title, startAt, allDay, location }. Link: '/calendar?event=<eventId>'.
